feed.title: Trump stuns Nvidia's Jensen Huang with an unexpected AI remark
feed.summary: Former President Donald Trump reportedly called AI a "hoax" during an unexpected onstage interaction with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to Seeking Alpha. This remark comes at a critical time when AI companies are heavily investing in infrastructure, with Nvidia being a major beneficiary of this buildout. Investors are now watching to see if political discourse will impact policies and spending that drive Nvidia's growth.

feed.title: Amex Graphite Business Card Review 2026: Is the $295 Fee Worth It?
feed.summary: The Amex Graphite Business Cash Unlimited Card, launched in March 2026, offers unlimited 2% cash back on eligible purchases and 5% on Amex Travel bookings, but carries a substantial $295 annual fee. Businesses need to spend at least $14,750 annually to offset this fee with cash back rewards. The card includes features like no preset spending limit, various protections, and a welcome bonus, making it potentially suitable for high-spending businesses or those with significant travel budgets.

feed.title: CenterPoint Energy Discloses Customer Data Breach in SEC Filing
feed.summary: CenterPoint Energy has disclosed a customer data breach in an SEC filing, revealing that an unauthorized third party accessed personal information through an external system. The utility company, based in Houston, Texas, stated that its electricity and gas delivery services remain unaffected. Although the full scope of the breach is still under investigation, CenterPoint Energy plans to notify affected customers and relevant authorities once more details are determined.

feed.title: Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy Pledge $1 Billion a Year to Virginia Suppliers
feed.summary: Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy have committed to a supplier program worth up to $1 billion annually for Virginia businesses as part of a broader package aimed at easing regulatory review of their proposed merger. The package also includes monthly residential bill credits, a strengthened EnergyShare program for low-income households, and a workforce training fund, alongside commitments to maintain and create jobs in Virginia. These commitments are designed to address concerns raised by Virginia's regulatory bodies and Governor Abigail Spanberger regarding the merger's impact on household bills, employment, and clean energy investments.

feed.title: Simon Approaching End Of The Road With Struggling Suburban Boston Mall
feed.summary: Simon Property Group is likely to relinquish ownership of its Square One Mall in Saugus, Massachusetts, as the $76 million CMBS loan tied to the property has been transferred to special servicing and is deemed almost impossible to refinance. The mall's net cash flow has declined annually since 2022, and its inclusion in Simon's "Other Properties" category suggests it will be handed back to lenders. This comes even as the broader mall sector shows signs of recovery, with Simon focusing its investments on better-performing properties in the Boston area.

feed.title: Northrop Grumman (NOC) Secures $4.8 Billion Army Contract. Execution Is the Bigger Test

feed.title: Franklin Templeton switches fund to Putnam

The move is driven by evolving investor preferences for lower-cost, diversified global equity options, with all changes expected by October 14.

feed.title: Jim Cramer on Procter & Gamble (PG): “They Don’t Have the Growth That I Want”
feed.summary: Jim Cramer expressed his reservations about Procter & Gamble (PG), stating that it lacks the growth he desires despite its 3% dividend yield, leading him to recommend selling the stock. Cramer's sentiment is further supported by the stock's modest growth trajectory and premium valuation, prompting a reallocation of capital towards faster-moving opportunities.
